# flexui

> Pure-Go desktop UI library: HTML + a flexbox-only CSS subset for views, Go for state and handlers, rendered by its own deterministic software renderer (no browser, no JS, no cgo). Module: github.com/sivaneshwararaj/flexui (Go 1.24+).

## Docs

- [Guide](docs/GUIDE.md): model, full public API, events, inputs, HTML/CSS subset, testing, pitfalls (start here)
- [Agent notes](AGENTS.md): the essentials in nine points
- [Spec](spec/SUBSET.md): exact supported subset and deviations from browsers
- [Status](spec/STATUS.md): what works, what is stubbed, known gaps
- [Architecture](spec/ARCHITECTURE.md): internals (for changing flexui)

## Examples

- [demo](examples/demo): contacts manager (list, form, modal) with headless golden tests
- [counter](examples/counter): minimal stateful app, `-window` for macOS/Windows
- [Go examples](example_test.go): RenderHTML, App with headless session, controlled and uncontrolled inputs

## Platforms

- [macOS backend](platform/darwin/README.md)
- [Windows backend](platform/windows/README.md)
